usage.callShape: GET https://trymimetic.com/x402/create-video?prompt=<text>&aspect_ratio=9:16&duration=15 (x402 payment of 10 USDC on Base)
usage.outputShape: body.job_id, body.token (Bearer for status), body.status_url, body.status, body.video_url (when status=completed)
quirks: Price is $10.00 (10 USDC, amount 10000000) on Base eip155:8453 — exceeds the QA $6 per-call ceiling, so it was NOT paid/tested (classification over-cap).
GET with query params; required param is prompt. Optional aspect_ratio (9:16|16:9|1:1|4:3|3:4, default 9:16) and duration (5|10|15 sec, default 15).
Async: response returns job_id + status_url + a Bearer token; poll status_url with header Authorization: Bearer <token> until status=completed, then read video_url.
usage.guide: Call GET https://trymimetic.com/x402/create-video with query params: prompt (required), optionally aspect_ratio (default 9:16) and duration (default 15s). Pay the x402 quote of 10 USDC on Base. The response is an async job returning job_id, a Bearer token, and a status_url. Poll status_url with header Authorization: Bearer <token> until status is "completed", then download the video from video_url. Note this endpoint costs $10/call which is above the QA $6 ceiling, so it was not actually paid or verified.
